title: capsicum indicum var. ovatum
intro: Capsicum indicum var. ovatum, commonly known as the eggplant or aubergine, is a variety of the nightshade family of plants. It is a rich source of essential nutrients, providing numerous health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving heart health, and supporting weight management. The therapeutic actions of eggplant include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties, making it a valuable component in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of C. indicum var. ovatum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
